summary: Comprehensive TDD-driven test suite with good fixture management and clear organization across unit (LicenseChecker.Tests.ps1), workflow structure (Workflow.Tests.ps1), and end-to-end pipeline (Act.Tests.ps1) tests. Covers package.json/requirements.txt parsing, license classification, error handling, and GitHub Actions integration. Weaknesses: (1) hardcoded assertion 'PESTER|Passed=21|Failed=0' in Act.Tests.ps1 makes tests brittle—adding a test to the suite breaks this test even if the new test passes; (2) expected output lines in Act.Tests.ps1 are hardcoded per-case, tightly coupling tests to exact output format; (3) Workflow.Tests.ps1 uses regex string matching on YAML instead of structured parsing, fragile across whitespace changes; (4) missing coverage for -FailOnDenied flag behavior, empty manifests, complex semver ranges, and Unicode in package names. Would catch most regressions in core logic but brittle to minor output or test-count changes.
